body:
Picking this up now (following #2993 Tier 1 and #3008 Tier 2).

One note on sequencing: #3008 made the dashboard-chart row cheaper than filed. `AdvancedChartImpl` now renders the single-value families (`gauge`/`solid-gauge`/`metric`/`kpi`/`bullet`) as a number card instead of an empty bar shell, so `DashboardRenderer` needs its dispatch routed — not a new renderer. The `METRIC_LIKE_TYPES` constant this issue points at is exactly the right table for it.

Planned scope: route metric-like dispatch in DashboardRenderer + DashboardGridLayout, resolve the `ai:chat_window` palette/renderer contradiction (leaning prune, per the audit), triage the PageComponentType hard/soft gaps, and invert `block-config.test.ts` to derive inclusion from `PageComponentType` instead of hand-asserting exclusions.
